title: Missing Person Heatmap Analysis
summary: A data mining system for clustering, predicting, and visualizing missing-person case hotspots in Metro Manila, Philippines, built with FastAPI/Streamlit interfaces. The requirements.txt lists sdv>=1.10.0 but no code in the evidence imports or calls it.
evidence: requirements.txt: sdv>=1.10.0; no matching usage pattern found in code
needs: No call site found for sdv despite dependency listing and 'demo.py generates sample records' claim; unverified whether SDV is actually used to synthesize demo data.
